statement.p: Find the minimum and maximum values of the function f(x)=e^{-x^2} on [-2,4]\text{.}

solution.p: the only critical point is x=0\text{.} The maximum occurs at x=0\text{,} giving f(0)=1\text{.} The minimum occurs at the endpoint farthest from 0\text{,} so the minimum value is e^{-16} approx var name="$min_rounded"/>\text{.}
